sv.title: Muntert på Wall Street – Anthropicägare stiger
sv.summary: USA-börserna inleder torsdagen med muntra miner när AI-bolaget Anthropics jättenotering lyfte stämningen. På bolagsnivå klättrar AI-jättens storägare Amazon och Alphabet i den inledande handel.

en.title: Cheerful on Wall Street – Anthropic owner rises
en.summary: US stock markets open Thursday in good spirits as the huge listing of AI company Anthropic lifted sentiment. At company level, Amazon and Alphabet, major shareholders in the AI giant, climb in early trading.
